{"claims":[{"claim_text":"America's public schools are more racially segregated today than they were in the late 1960s.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Schools and programs within schools continue to be segregated by race and class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Students are being unnecessarily and unlawfully segregated by disability and language status.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Students are being unnecessarily and unlawfully segregated through the use of exclusionary discipline and school-based arrests.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Schools must no longer engage in segregation and segregative practices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support appointing judges who will enforce the Civil Rights Act in schools.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fund federal programs to promote integration and school diversity, including magnet schools and school transportation initiatives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reinvigorate and increase funding for the Department of Education's Office of Civil Rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will expand the civil rights data collection to inform civil rights enforcement and the public on the status of equal educational opportunity for all children.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will build on the Strength in Diversity Act to increase federal funding for community-driven strategies to desegregate schools.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
